name: Shindou Ritomo
source:
"I met you again. that's enough. Fufu, please don't make such a troubled face. Because it's true."

He is the assistant professor of biology at Imperial University. He is the eldest son of the noble Shindou family and the older brother of Masanari. He is gentle, well-liked, and respected by others.

Unlike his brother, he has chosen the path of a scholar.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/chouchoujiken/chara/index5.php]official website[/url]]
